import os, tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    w=lambda n,t: open(os.path.join(d,n),'w').write(t)
    w('a.conf','a=1\n@include b.conf\n'); w('b.conf','@include a.conf\n')
    w('s.conf','@include s.conf\n'); w('c.conf','@include nope.conf\n')
    for f in ['a.conf','s.conf','c.conf']:
        try: load(os.path.join(d,f))
        except ConfigError as e: print('ConfigError')
    os.mkdir(os.path.join(d,'sub'))
    w('sub/x.conf','k=inner\n@include ../y.conf\n'); w('y.conf','z=2\nk=y\n')
    w('m.conf','k=before\n@include sub/x.conf\n')
    c=load(os.path.join(d,'m.conf')); print(c.get('k'),c.get('z'))
EOF
